global.method: First 100 domains in the public Similarweb global monthly-visits table; eligibility pending.

poland.method: Semrush Poland public top 20 by visits, followed by unseen Ahrefs Poland top 100 by organic search. A mixed-metric testing shortlist, not a total-traffic top 100.

europe.method: Union of public Semrush top 20 in each of EU27 + UK + EFTA4; order by sum of reciprocal country rank (equal country weight), then domain. A balanced testing shortlist, not an aggregate traffic ranking.
